Name: Shie-Esque Tristan Portraits
Author: Stephamoeba
Description:
[u]UPDATE[/u]: 01/13/23
Now has a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] mod version.
This file is located under the "Optional Files" section of the Files tab.
This version of Shie-Esque Tristan Portraits does NOT require PyTK.
[b](However, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10971]HD Portraits[/url] requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14700]AeroCore[/url] to run properly)[/b]

-------------
A portrait mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6675]lemurkat's Tristan NPC mod[/url].
There are three portrait options: auburn, dark, and light.
Just like lemurkat's original mod, the [b]default is set to auburn[/b].

You can change what version of the portrait is shown in the config.json (Or in the Mod Config Menu if you have that installed).
(You can also change the default in the content.json file)

This imitates the art style of Shielia from their mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]SHIE'S PORTRAITS﻿﻿[/url]﻿, so please be sure to support their work!
If you are looking for a Content Patcher forms of Shie's portraits...[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8361]Shie's Portraits for Content Patcher by leifcg﻿﻿[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9635]﻿Shie's Portraits for SVE Content Patcher by AlmostMidnight﻿[/url]﻿
[/list]


[b]MOD REQUIREMENTS:[/b][list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)
[*]PyTK (Platonymous Toolkit)
[*]SHIE'S PORTRAITS
[*]Tristan
[*]East Scarp
[*]Mister Ginger (cat NPC)
[*]The Ranch Expansion Marnie and Jas
[/list]

[b]INSTALLATION GUIDE:[/b]
Simply download the zip folder, unzip it, and place the unzipped folder within your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
(Example: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
